ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food web/food chain diagram. On the left side there are many kinds of plants, including Corn, Carrots, Flowering shrub, and Tree at the bottom; on the right side and in the middle there are animals such as Mouse, Rabbit, Grasshopper, Deer, Frog, Snake, Shrew, Hawk, Wolf, etc., and arrows are used to indicate feeding relationships. Tree is located at the lower left, is a plant, and is at the starting point of the food relationship leading to consumers such as deer. Reasoning: primary producer refers to an organism that can make its own food and is at the first trophic level, usually a green plant. According to the labels in the image and the food chain indicated by the question, Tree is the producer.
